names.note: His own name, read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 iunie, «Sfinţii Mucenici Marchian, Nicandru, Iperehie, Apolon, Leonid, Arie, Gheorghe, Selneniad, Irineu şi Pamvon», which names ten men.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 523 gives it, «Горгий (Гордий) Египетский, мч.», with the rank word taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'египетскии горгии' has no other holder. **The parenthesis holds a SECOND READING OF THE FORENAME and not a surname**: name page 523 heads him «Горгий (Гордий) Египетский, мч.», and Гордий is Gordius, a different name from Gorgias. On the standing reading for «Квинтилиан (Кинтилиан)» the variant is recorded in the note and NOT stored in the form, which is the opposite of what a twentieth-century surname gets. **Also worth saying: this folder's display name is `George of Egypt` and its Romanian form «Gheorghe», where the Russian calendar's name is Горгий, Gorgias — not Георгий, George. The corpus's English form came from the Romanian and the Russian does not confirm it; it is a question for the author and nothing was renamed.**

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Маркиана , Никандра , Иперехия , Аполлона , Леонида , Ария , Горгия , Селиния , Ириния и Памвона (ок. 305-311).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry of twelve, «Мчч. Маркиана , Никандра , Иперехия , Аполлона , Леонида , Ария , Горгия , Селиния , Ириния и Памвона (ок. 305-311).», one line naming TEN people and giving them one bracket; ten `name:` links stand under it, one for each, and all ten already had folders in this corpus, every one of them kept on this same menologion day by the Romanian or the Greek calendar or both. Nine of the ten name links point at one life, `life1237`, which was NOT read; the tenth, Леонид, points at an index of its own, `id1340`, which was not followed either. The identification rests on the day, on the ten names in the calendar's own order, on the year, and on the Egypt nine of the ten name pages give each of them. The year the line gives the company, «(ок. 305-311)», is the reading each folder was to be measured against one at a time; where a folder already held a date it was left alone and the line's interval is recorded here. The day page prints eleven hymns, for two Solovki abbots, a bishop of Tyre, a prince of Chernigov, a metropolitan of Kyiv and a prince of Novgorod, and NONE under any of these ten names. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 iunie — «Sfinţii Mucenici Marchian, Nicandru, Iperehie, Apolon, Leonid, Arie, Gheorghe, Selneniad, Irineu şi Pamvon»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες εν Αιγύπτω»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and carries the whole company on one page under the day's line «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες εν Αιγύπτω», with a head line for each of the ten: Μαρκιανός, Νίκανδρος, Απόλλων, Λεωνίδης, Γοργίας, Ειρήνη, Σελληνιάδα, Άρειος, Υπερέχιος, Παμβών. The account matches the folder's: they were denounced to the idolatrous eparch of Alexandria, confessed boldly, and were condemned to die of hunger and thirst, left naked days on end in the cold of winter while the soldiers ate and drank in front of them, and died unshaken. The Greek says in so many words that the company held women — the eparch hoped to frighten «τουλάχιστον τις γυναίκες» into sacrificing, and «άνδρες και γυναίκες, πέθαναν απαρασάλευτοι» — and it puts the feminine article on three of the ten names. The corpus reads all ten as men, after doxologia; that disagreement is recorded here and nothing is changed on it. No hymn is printed. **No Greek name form is stored on this folder.** The Greek list and the Romanian list each hold exactly ten names and eight of them answer to each other plainly, but the two that remain do not: saint.gr's «Γοργιας» and «Ειρηνη» stand where doxologia has Gheorghe and Irineu, and Ειρήνη is a woman's name with the feminine article on it. Pairing the remaining two by elimination would be deciding a name form, which is not a reader's to decide, so this folder takes the Greek day and no Greek name, and the question is left open in the report.
